description: R5/M18 (§23, K33, K34, Ö37): the same story list for three readers. Ana gets every story; Bora (bars, no licensed flow) reads the public world: no licensed story, only the server comments on that data in the range; Can (no data entitlement) gets digit-free faces. No value, confidence, importance, ledger count or data digest derived from licensed data reaches Bora or Can.
